subject: Urgent: Ceiling condensation drip on demo island — immediate evacuation & remote handoff
body:
From: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@venueco.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai; vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Venue Maintenance <maint@venueco.com>
Date: 18 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B

Hi Logan / Vanessa,

Heads up from the floor: the HVAC unit above Demo Island B is showing condensation and there's an active drip onto one of the demo tables (near the main power strip). Maintenance is en route but wanted to flag immediately so you can move equipment off the table and protect gear.

I attached a quick photo. Maintenance ETA ~18 minutes; I'll update when they start the fix.

[attachment: ceiling_drip_1.jpg (image/jpeg)]

— Oliver
Venue Operations, VenueCo

----

From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@venueco.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@saaspartner.com>
Date: 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B

Thanks Oliver — good catch. Team, quick playbook:
- Vanessa/onsite: please move all demo hardware (laptops, demo kiosks, power strips) off that table immediately to the storage cart across aisle C. Unplug fragile gear first.
- Mina: prep the backup laptop and Mobile Hotspot in Booth A (ID 3). If the on-site demo needs to switch to remote, we should be able to stream from Booth A.
- Aditya: coordinate with Emma (SaaSPartner) to switch her 10:30 live demo to a remote session if the table stays damp. Get Zoom link ready and confirm who will present remotely.

Vanessa — are there tarps or plastic covers available on-site? If not, please use cardboard and signage to cordon off until maintenance closes the leak. Take photos after the kit is moved.

Do not attempt to power any equipment that got wet. If any device shows even a mist, mark it and we'll send it to vendor for inspection.

I cc'd Emma so she knows there may be a last-minute change.

— Logan
Head of Field Events, Redwood Inference

----

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@venueco.com>
Date: 18 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B

On the floor now. Small but steady drip directly above demo table 2 (closest to aisle). Maintenance team here and putting down a tarp under the unit — we are moving the two laptops and the Raspberry demo kit to the storage cart by Booth A.

Photos attached BEFORE we moved the kit and the storage placement after. I unplugged the power strip and labeled cables. No visible moisture on screens, only on table surface.

[attachment: demokit_photo_before_move.jpg (image/jpeg)]

I also spoke with Emma's lead, Rachel, who said Emma can go remote — they have an engineer ready to present and can dial in at 10:30. Emma, if you prefer to keep a short in-person portion, we can re-site to Booth D (dry) but that will add a 4–6 min walk time for attendees.

Vanessa
Sr. Field Producer, Redwood Inference

----

From: Emma Li <emma.li@saaspartner.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai; vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai; aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 18 Aug 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B

Thanks for the heads up — we can definitely go remote. Our engineer, Marco (marco@saaspartner.com), can present from our hotel room and share the screen. Please have someone hand him the HDMI dongle and the USB camera when he arrives at 10:15 so he can run a quick AV check. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (passcode: 4rThr9)

We'll keep the in-person demo flexible so you can decide once maintenance clears the area.

— Emma
Head of Partnerships, SaaSPartner Inc.

----

From: mina.haddad@redwood.ai
To: logan.wright@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 18 Aug 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B

Confirmed — backup laptop is staged at Booth A, Mobile Hotspot is charged and SIM tested (5 bars). Aditya, I left the HDMI dongle and USB camera in the Booth A tech box (labeled SAASP-10:30).

If we go remote: I can run the remote demo from Booth A and act as on-site producer; Vanessa can MC? Let me know if we should switch to the Zoom link now to test audio at 10:15.

Mina
Events Tech Lead, Redwood Inference

----

From: logan.wright@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Oliver Hughes <oliver.hughes@venueco.com>, Emma Li <emma.li@saaspartner.com>, Venue Maintenance <maint@venueco.com>
Date: 18 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: URGENT — condensation drip over Demo Island B — RESOLVED

Thanks team — closing the loop:
- Maintenance confirmed faulty condensate line replaced; workorder 98321 completed at 12:40. (see attached workorder PDF).
- Demo kit relocated to Booth A cart at 09:22, no equipment damaged. Vanessa and Mina verified no moisture on devices; Mina ran device checks.
- Emma ran remote demo at 10:30 using our Booth A hotspot; streaming quality good, no audience complaints captured.
- Incident report attached; finance, please route any consumable replacements (table covers, cable labels) to events expense under code EVT-2026-08-WTR.
- Action items: schedule a quick vendor inspection next week to confirm HVAC seal; add a laminated "Do Not Place Equipment Under HVAC" sign to our booth kit.

Thanks for the quick ops response and to VenueCo for fast maintenance.

Attachments: incident_report_20260818.pdf, venue_workorder_98321.pdf

— Logan
Head of Field Events, Redwood Inference

----

Quoted message example (from Vanessa's 09:18 reply):
> On the floor now. Small but steady drip directly above demo table 2 (closest to aisle). Maintenance team here and putting down a tarp under the unit — we are moving the two laptops and the Raspberry demo kit to the storage cart by Booth A.
>
> Photos attached BEFORE we moved the kit and the storage placement after. I unplugged the power strip and labeled cables. No visible moisture on screens, only on table surface.

"This thread will be kept in the event folder for the August Summit — incident log added to the shared drive."
